source_text: Cui infusum est oleum chrismatis. Unctio Spiritus. Christiani a Christo.
pass_a_gloss: To-whom poured-on is oil of-chrism. Anointing of-Spirit. Christians from Christ.
pass_b_english: On whom the [[oil of anointing is poured >> Bible:Leviticus 21:10]] — the Spirit’s unction. Christians take their name from Christ.
